# Review

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:Review`](gmeow-Review.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/Review>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/software`](../../slices/software.md)

A code review or peer review of a merge request or commit — an [`InformationObject`](gmeow-InformationObject.md) carrying review text, approval state, and requested changes. The reviewing activity itself is a [`gmeow:Event`](gmeow-Event.md) with gmeow:Participations.

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gmeow:InformationObject`](gmeow-InformationObject.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:Review`](gmeow-Review.md) as a specialized kind of [`gmeow:InformationObject`](gmeow-InformationObject.md). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.
